decision.reason: FreightWaves SONAR source confirms intermodal contract rates decreased $1.68 -> $1.61/mile while truck spot and contractual prices moved differently. This supplies a concrete shipper mode-selection scenario; first-party market evidence only, no customer proof.

opportunities.core_job: Compare user-provided contract/spot/intermodal lane costs and service-risk assumptions before tender award
opportunities.target_customer: Shippers, 3PL transportation procurement teams and freight forwarders
opportunities.product_mechanism: Upload historical lane CSV -> enter mode-specific current contracted quotes and transit/missed-delivery exposure -> deterministic normalized landed cost and SLA comparisons -> signed tender decision evidence
opportunities.why_now: SONAR 13 October 2026 reported declining intermodal contract prices against firm carrier pricing power, creating a scenario-review trigger.
opportunities.before_state: Carrier bids and intermodal alternatives are reviewed in separate spreadsheets without decision assumptions or approvals.
opportunities.after_state: Lane-level comparison and signed scenario record explain mode/tender award under changing rates.

source_check.rss_title: SONAR Pricing Power Index Slips to 70 as Intermodal Contract Rates Fall - FreightWaves
